name: Isosurface extraction on arbitrary polyhedral grids
aliases: Generalized marching cubes for arbitrary grids
Isosurface extraction on arbitrary polyhedral cells
Method for isosurface extraction on arbitrary polyhedral cells
definition: A method to extract isosurfaces from scalar fields defined on arbitrary polyhedral cells (cubic, tetrahedral, distorted, non-convex irregular), avoiding the topological inconsistencies of standard Marching Cubes on ambiguous faces by treating face boundaries systematically.
